sql: WITH table_0 AS (SELECT * FROM fixture.accounts), table_1 AS (SELECT id AS p_id, tenant AS p_tenant, name AS p_name, score AS p_score, rank AS p_rank, CAST(66 AS bigint) AS nonce FROM table_0 AS "originé" ORDER BY p_id DESC, p_tenant, p_name, p_score, p_rank, nonce LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1), table_2 AS (SELECT p_tenant, p_score, p_rank, nonce, p_score - CAST($1 AS integer) AS "derived49a%b_c", id AS p_id, name AS p_name FROM table_1 AS "nested33'") SELECT nonce, "derived49a%b_c" FROM table_2 AS "nested51雪" ORDER BY p_id DESC, p_tenant, p_name, p_score, p_rank, nonce
